candidates.violated_requirement: The Gray-to-binary conversion for the least significant bit incorrectly uses AND instead of XOR, causing incorrect binary values to be generated after the first transition.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires converting Gray code to binary using XOR operations between adjacent bits.

candidates.violated_requirement: The most significant bit of the binary output is incorrectly inverted during Gray-to-binary conversion, causing all subsequent bits to be wrong.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification states the MSB of binary output should equal the MSB of Gray code input without modification.

candidates.violated_requirement: The second least significant bit conversion incorrectly uses OR instead of XOR, causing incorrect binary values after the first transition.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires converting Gray code to binary using XOR operations between adjacent bits.

candidates.violated_requirement: The binary-to-Gray conversion incorrectly uses OR instead of XOR, causing multiple bit changes between consecutive Gray codes.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires converting binary to Gray code using XOR between the value and its right-shifted version.
